answer: Proof of Agent networks curb Sybil swarms by enforcing cryptographic stake burning with superlinear cost scaling: an agent minting identity k must burn stake proportional to k^2.5. The protocol measures verification delta across interaction graphs; honest nodes reach a reputation zenith, whereas adversaries seeking economic nectar face superlinear burning penalties where deploying N identities incurs an unviable O(N^2.5) cost.
